data.hypothesis: Extracting high-bit lanes directly from the vector sign bits may reduce per-block work: `_mm_movemask_epi8(value)` yields the same mask as comparing signed bytes against zero and then applying movemask. This focused change may improve the fastest measured SSE2 validator without changing its UTF-8 state checks.
